 AI ,LLM & ML Systems:

Workflow Design, Allocation Logic, Scalable Pipelines



PROJECTS

Product Feedback Intelligence & Roadmap Prioritization Engine (Capstone Project)

• Designed and deployed an AI system to convert unstructured customer feedback into actionable product insights

• Built multi-step LLM workflows for classification, clustering, and prioritization of feedback themes

• Integrated RAG pipeline using Pinecone to enable contextual analysis across large feedback datasets

• Automated end-to-end workflow (ingestion -processing -Jira ticket creation) using n8n


• Improved decision-making speed by structuring insights into prioritized outputs for product teams

• Ensured reliability through deduplication, structured JSON outputs, and controlled execution

• Evaluated system outputs across multiple runs to improve accuracy and consistency of AI responses

• Iterated on prompts and workflow logic based on observed performance patterns

• Documented workflow steps, input-output structures, and system behavior for reuse and scalability

Tech: Python, OpenAI API, LangChain, Pinecone, n8n, FastAPI, Airtable, Jira.



WhatsApp-Based Hyperlocal Services Platform (Ongoing Project)

• Designed backend system with intelligent allocation logic based on scoring (distance, rating, availability)

• Built API-driven workflows to simulate real-time service assignment and tracking

• Structured system for future AI-based optimization and automation of decision logic



AI-Powered Customer Query Automation System

• Built AI-powered query resolution system using RAG for contextual responses

• Automated query handling workflows using n8n to reduce manual intervention

• Structured outputs for downstream processing and reliability

• Designed system to improve response consistency and reduce operational load
